article.summary_es: El Remanente Food Pantry es una despensa de alimentos en el Bronx que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Abre los sábados de 11am a 12:30pm.
article.summary_en: El Remanente Food Pantry is a food pantry in the Bronx listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It is open Saturdays from 11am to 12:30pm.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está ubicada en 1402 Crotona Park E, Bronx, NY 10460.
La despensa funciona el primer y tercer sábado del mes.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni si hay requisitos; pregunte directamente.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 1402 Crotona Park E, Bronx, NY 10460.
It is open Saturdays from 11am to 12:30pm.
The pantry runs on the 1st and 3rd Saturday of the month.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are requirements; ask directly.
